verdicts.reason: A loses the floral wreath, which is the key imagery: it is shrunk to a tiny speck near the lower left, leaving a bare white circle on a mostly empty black banner, so the design is no longer recognisable. B keeps the wreath at a readable size, but pulls it away from the text circle and sets it as an empty ring on the left, so the frame-around-message idea is gone; the circle is also clipped at the top and bottom edges and the right third is dead space.
